findings.title: Synology-SA-24:20 Security Advisory (DSM Pwn2Own 2024)
findings.summary_md: Synology published SA-24:20 on 5 November 2024 covering CVE-2024-10441, CVE-2024-10445, and CVE-2024-50629 in DSM. The advisory lists patches released in December 2024 and describes the flaws as allowing arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file read, and arbitrary file write on unpatched NAS appliances.

findings.title: BleepingComputer: Synology warns of C3RB3r ransomware attacks
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reported on 29 October 2026 that Synology warned of active C3RB3r ransomware attacks exploiting a December 2024-patched flaw. The article notes the company linked to SA-24:20 for CVE-2024-10441, CVE-2024-50629, and CVE-2024-10445, and advised users to block the management web interface from the internet.
